rv.q: Michael Griffo's warm, evocative language and the excellent acting in this two-hander make Pen Pals, currently playing at Theatre at St. Clement's, truly special.
Vardalos, especially, made us believe that we’re getting to know a full human being who just happens to express herself through two-dimensional text.
What is not discussed is the volatile world these two lived in.
Griffo’s play seems to hit a nerve with the mostly older audience...

cn.t: Critics find this epistolary two-hander sweetly predictable but well-acted, with warm writing that echoes "Love Letters." Reception ranges from enthusiastic praise for its emotional resonance to criticism of its unchallenging structure.
